notes: The target_reaction obligation is bound via a two-part query over the same message_reactions rows: focal enforces the reactor's membership in #project-alpha-dev, and auxiliary independently enforces that the reacted-to message is the Postgres 16 migration announcement in #core-infra. Both constraints apply to the same root row (same reaction record), preserving the design's same-record binding requirement without needing a branching join path. The thank_you_reply obligation's selector identifies the migration announcement message (the thread parent) by channel name and content, since the write action itself (thread_ts + chat.postMessage) is performed by the agent using the reactor's real name (Łukasz Kowalski) discovered via the target_reaction/reactor_user bindings. Actor (U01AGENBOT9) already holds memberships in #core-infra, #project-alpha-dev, and #random per the base seed, satisfying discovery requirements without additional edits. Added channel_members rows for U_MATEO and U_KENJI in #random ensure coherent record provenance for the new lunch message and its reaction, though not strictly required by the API contract.
